## Hello, I'm Annamalai Vikash Raam Manoj.

I'm a Business Analytics student at Monash University with a background in Computer Science.

I'm interested in what happens when raw data becomes something people can actually understand and use. This site is where I'll share projects, visual explorations, and stories I've built along the way.

## Projects & data stories

A collection of work exploring data, the questions it raises, and the ways we can communicate what we find.
